The house

A low, modern house that follows the curve of the coast — all glass, pale stone and water.

The Wave is built into the hillside above S'Estanyol, with a long living room that opens to a pool terrace on one side and a shaded garden on the other. The architecture is restrained; the view does the talking.

Five bedrooms, all en suite, are arranged for privacy: two on the upper floor, three at garden level. The kitchen is a serious one, and the outdoor table seats twelve.
